subject:
CPAN board: cause-classify the 65 PARTIAL files (the 674 failing assertions) — the FAIL half is done</subject>
<parameter name="description">NEXT STEP of the s343 survey (docs/cpan-board14-survey-s343.md). The FAIL half is measured and classified; the PARTIAL half is not, and that is where the failing assertions actually are.

DONE s343: whole 14-dist board in one run at 9615196 / gen v2-105 — 65 PASS, 65 PARTIAL, 53 FAIL of 183 files; 1794 ok / 674 not-ok. Data in docs/cpan-board14-s343.tsv and docs/cpan-board14-fail-causes-s343.tsv.

THE METHOD THAT MATTERS (do not skip it): run every candidate file under REAL PERL too. The board's FAIL rule is "zero ok", so a file with no assertions counts as a failure — 12 of the 53 FAILs are files perl SKIPs entirely (author tests: Text-Balanced 9x_*.t, *-report-prereqs.t) or cannot run either. Real failures: 41, not 53. Script used: scratchpad oracle.pl (compare against `perl -Ilib -It/lib t/FILE`).

TODO: for each of the 65 PARTIAL files capture the FIRST not-ok row + its diagnostic, and the perl oracle verdict, then group into families the way the FAIL half grouped (it collapsed 41 files into ~4 causes + singles). Write the result beside docs/cpan-board14-survey-s343.md.

Known from the FAIL half, likely to recur in the PARTIALs:
 - Capture-Tiny "invalid number of arguments: 1" (task #201) — 10 FAIL files already.
 - Role/method-modifier cluster (tasks #135, Class-Method-Modifiers) incl. "read error during load" = unreadable emission.
 - XS boundary: "Can't locate loadable object for module X" (Storable/Encode/namespace::clean) — deliberate, not a compiler bug.
 - Test::More `subtest` is NOT implemented in PCL's TAP layer (cl/pcl-test.lisp) — Mojo-DOM58 collection.t dies on it; likely costs assertions in other dists too.
 - Scalar-List-Utils has 21 PARTIAL files (XS-stubbed dist, --no-dist-lib) — expect many of the 674 not-ok rows to sit there; check how many are XS-inherent before counting them as bugs.</description>
